name: bbe
why: Sed-like editor for binary files, a direct tool for rewriting bytes and poking at file formats.

brief.what_it_is: bbe is a command-line editor for binary files, described by its own page as "a sed-like editor for binary files." Where sed reads input line by line, bbe reads arbitrary blocks from an input stream and applies byte-related transformations to the blocks it finds. It takes a binary file or stream as input and writes the transformed bytes out. The SourceForge page gives no usage examples, so the exact script syntax is not confirmed from what I read.
brief.why_it_exists: The page's only statement of purpose is the block-oriented contrast with sed: sed assumes line-structured text, and bbe is meant for data that has no line structure.
brief.how_it_works: According to the SourceForge description, bbe reads arbitrary blocks from an input stream and performs byte-related transformations on the blocks it finds, rather than splitting input into lines as sed does. I did not see a README or documentation describing the command language or block-matching syntax.
brief.install_notes: Nothing beyond the Homebrew formula was visible. The SourceForge page lists the operating systems as BSD and Linux and the user interface as command-line, with C as the programming language. No build steps, dependencies, or first-run configuration were shown.
brief.standout: The block-based model is the distinguishing idea: it treats a binary file as a stream of blocks to match and rewrite, where sed treats it as lines, which suits file-format poking and byte patching.
brief.status: Quiet, possibly abandoned. The SourceForge page shows a last update of 2013-04-29 and a project registration date of 2005-09-21, with 341 downloads this week and no user reviews. No newer release or commit was visible in what I could read. The page appears to be a generic SourceForge project page, not a maintained project site.
brief.caveats: The SourceForge page is mostly site chrome and ads, with almost no project documentation. The 'bbe Web Site' link on it had no visible URL, and my guess at a project site (http://bbe-.sourceforge.net/) failed to load, so the project's own documentation was not reached. License is GPL version 2. Platform listed as BSD and Linux, so macOS support via Homebrew is not confirmed by the page.
quotes: bbe is a sed-like editor for binary files.
Instead of reading input in lines as sed, bbe reads arbitrary blocks from an input stream and performs byte-related transformations on found blocks.
